nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template for backend environment variables, defining the local SQLite dev database URL and the Postgres URL used by the functional test suite.

nodes.name: alembic.ini
nodes.summary: Alembic migration tool configuration pointing to the backend/alembic migration scripts directory and configuring logging for schema migrations.

nodes.name: pytest.ini
nodes.summary: Pytest configuration setting the test discovery path and registering the 'postgres' marker used to separate fast SQLite tests from Postgres-functional tests.

nodes.name: requirements-dev.txt
nodes.summary: Development-only Python dependencies (psycopg2-binary, pyyaml) needed to run the Postgres-functional test suite locally.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Core backend Python dependencies for the FastAPI application, including SQLAlchemy, Alembic, pydantic-settings, pytest, and the casparser CAS-parsing library.
